title: Keep one arm by validation
summary: Joins the arms of a screen and keeps the best by its validation score; the test part stays shut.
does: Planned as a block: every arm's checkpoint is ranked by its validation score and one is kept, so the test part is read once, after the choice. The experiments' pre-registration chooses the next combination from the validation part alone; today tools/block_sweep.py ledger reads the recorded runs that way, by hand. Its job (1 CPU, 8 GB, 1 hour) is the sandbox's allowance; nothing has measured it.

today.note: tools/block_sweep.py ledger ranks recorded runs on validation by hand
